beats.text: Meet Aarav. It is two in the morning, and his project is due tomorrow.
Like millions of people in India, Aarav speaks Hinglish. Most voice assistants do not.
This is Bolo. It is small enough to live on his laptop, and it understands Hinglish.
Bolo writes down what he said, works out what he wants, and checks that the folder really exists. Then the terminal opens.
It knows twenty kinds of commands. Music, timers, reminders, messages, settings, and more.
And when it is not sure, it asks, instead of guessing.
Everything runs on the laptop itself. No internet, no cloud. His voice never leaves his machine.
On {N_WORDS} test commands, spoken in computer voices it never trained on, Bolo picked the right action {E2E_WORDS} percent of the time. Real voices are being tested now.
Bolo. Open source, and free. Try it, and tell us where it fails.
